title: Agent session, TinyStories, 20 to 21 October 2026
note: 49 experiments by the agent from the night of 20 October to midday on 21 October 2026, in 10-minute runs, from the starter recipe (full attention, the starter kit's since 20 October), on TinyStories with its own tokenizer. It paused from 03:20 to 07:27 when the agent's sign-in expired. The first recipe was trained three times to measure the noise.
